rows.headline: RBI Governor flags mounting global risks despite domestic resilience
rows.hook: Strong domestic growth offers no global immunity
rows.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Malhotra warned that current domestic economic resilience does not guarantee immunity against external shocks. He highlighted persistent global risks that could impact domestic financial stability. The warning serves as a caution for policymakers and market participants navigating international headwinds. Indian retail investors should monitor how external volatility affects domestic market valuations and macroeconomic stability.
